exploit_name: Inflated liquidation bonus against PLPs due to commission exclusion
description: settleBurn returns tokenPaid before commission is burned, excluding commission fees from the value reported to liquidation bonus calculation.
root_cause: settleBurn returns tokenPaid before commission is burned, excluding commission fees from the value reported to liquidation bonus calculation.
fix_description: Include commission fee in returned tokenPaid or return commission separately and incorporate before bonus calculation.
notes: Liquidators receive larger bonuses than warranted, creating protocol loss when commissions are non-zero.
